verdict.rationale: Unleash's docs say the Admin API offers full programmatic access to all resources, including flags, projects, environments, users and integrations. They also say this same API powers the Admin UI, which strongly implies UI/API parity. The support rests only on vendor overview statements. missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation showing parity for specific UI workflows (e.g. change requests, release templates, RBAC), independent or hands-on corroboration that nothing is UI-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.
This API powers the Unleash Admin UI and enables automation workflows.
The Admin API provides comprehensive programmatic access to all Unleash resources.
